title: Find matching public jobs across employer ATS boards
description: Read official public Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby feeds. No login, API key or proxy required. Filters apply before saving and job-saved billing. These are employer boards, not a global job search.

boards.title: Employer job boards
boards.description: Provider:slug entries or public board URLs, up to 30. Examples greenhouse:stripe, lever:leverdemo, ashby:Ashby. Lever EU uses lever-eu:slug. Ashby capitalization is retained.

maxJobs.title: Maximum saved jobs per run
maxJobs.description: Global cap after normalization, deduplication and filtering. Also bounded by your run spending limit.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Maximum saved jobs per employer board
maxJobsPerBoard.description: Per-board saved job cap. Capped boards are marked partial; this is not a full hiring count.

includeTitleKeywords.title: Title contains any of these keywords
includeTitleKeywords.description: Case-insensitive substring OR matching. Empty means all titles. Up to 30 terms.

excludeTitleKeywords.title: Exclude titles containing any keyword
excludeTitleKeywords.description: Case-insensitive substring exclusions, applied after the inclusion list. Up to 30 terms.

locationKeywords.title: Location contains any keyword
locationKeywords.description: Case-insensitive OR matching against published location labels. No inferred geography.

remoteOnly.title: Explicitly remote roles only
remoteOnly.description: Requires a provider's explicit remote field. Greenhouse list feeds usually lack this and will be excluded; a remote-looking title is not enough. Hybrid is excluded.

publishedAfter.title: Published on or after (optional)
publishedAfter.description: ISO date or timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01. Jobs without a publication date are excluded when set. Greenhouse updated_at is not publication; Lever's public feed generally lacks publication dates. Ashby reports last publication.

knownJobIds.title: Previously saved job keys
knownJobIds.description: Paste KNOWN_JOB_IDS from a previous run. These stable jobKey values are skipped before saving/billing. Up to 10,000; the output retains the newest 10,000 if its rolling union grows larger.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-request timeout in seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Each request is retried at most once for transient failures.

minDelaySeconds.title: Minimum pause between requests to one provider
minDelaySeconds.description: Requests are sequential and paced; rate-limit responses use a bounded retry delay. Long server retry requests fail safely.
